experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/cluster.ts

Seeded globular-cluster starfield texture — the no-photo
Sourcesrc/experiments/star-field/engine/bodies/procedural/cluster.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

_STAR_COUNT

Resolved-star count inside the King profile — dense enough that the core reads as blended light, sparse enough that edge members stay individually resolvable. Canvas px budget only; the real clusters carry ~10⁵ members.

_CORE_FRAC

Core radius as a fraction of the half-canvas (r_c ≈ 0.14 r_t).

clusterRadius

Rejection-sampled radius for one cluster star — draws u∈[0,1) as a candidate along the radial axis and keeps it with probability Σ(r)/Σ(0), concentrating draws inside the flat core.

  • @param rand Seeded RNG.
  • @returns Radius in half-canvas units (0 center → 1 edge).

clusterFor

Paints the seeded globular-cluster texture — unresolved core glow + King-sampled star speckles, used by makeNebulaSprite when a cluster catalog entry carries no photo map.

  • @param THREE The three.js module.
  • @param def Cluster def (id seeds the swarm, color tints the core).
  • @returns A CanvasTexture for the sprite map, or undefined.
